title: Fast and Slow Pointers
intuition: Also known as Floyd's cycle detection. Use two pointers moving at different speeds to detect cycles or find specific nodes.
step_by_step_strategy: Initialize slow and fast pointers at head.
Advance slow by 1 step, fast by 2 steps.
If fast reaches null, there is no cycle.
If fast equals slow, a cycle is detected.
common_mistakes: Not checking next or next.next pointers on fast for nulls
Forgetting to initialize at the same node
content: Also known as Floyd's cycle detection. Use two pointers moving at different speeds to detect cycles or find specific nodes.
